alex: Heads-up: VM3 started showing +1.2GB steady mem growth after long-context runs. Profiling points to KV cache fragmentation in 1M-4M token windows. snapshot:

```
alloc_histogram:
  128: 12%
  256: 46%  <-- many small blocks
  512: 22%
  1024: 10%
holes_map: many small free slots scattered across slabs
```

maria: Can you paste the allocator config?

alex: config: kv_block_size_hint=256; slab_min=65536; slab_max=8388608; compact_threshold=0.9; compaction_mode=off
logs: "evicted 12 slices, freed 1.8MB, fragmentation 0.74"

tj: This matches bucket skew. Two quick ideas: bump kv_block_size_hint->512 to reduce micro-churn, or implement background compactor that coalesces adjacent free slots into larger blocks. Both trade memory vs CPU.

chloe: compact-on-evict tends to hurt p99 under burst. In a canary I saw ~10ms p99 regression when compaction runs inline.

alex: I ran quick A/B: compact-on-evict@0.6 reduced steady mem by ~700MB on a 4M-token test, p99 +10ms, throughput -1.5%.

maria: What about a lazy mover: mark free ranges and relocate only when adjacent free > X or when under memory pressure? Also try bucket rebalance that favors same-size reuse.

tj: Proto sketch:
```
for bucket in buckets:
  if frag_ratio(bucket) > 0.75 and bucket.age > 60s:
    schedule_repack(bucket, budget_ms=5)
```
repack moves cold KV pages, updates pointers atomically, yields to request loop.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: queued canary for branch=kv-compact-proto, job=perf-microbench #482 :rocket:

alex: I'll write a short RFC with perf numbers + config knobs. Will run larger load test tomorrow. Ping me if you want to pair on microbench.
